OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

BID_KIND_ANY().notice: Empty assetIds: the bid accepts shares of any miner that is tradable at fill time.

expireListing(uint256).notice: Anyone may clean an expired listing; funds remain with its owner.

feeManager().notice: Compatibility getter: the CURRENT owner, zero after renouncing.

initialFeeManager().notice: Immutable deployment identity; never used as an access grant.

quotePayment(uint256,uint256).notice: Rounded down per fill, just like buy/buyBatch. No fee is taken from the purchased H or from seller proceeds. Network gas is separate.

setFeeRecipient(address).notice: Only changes the destination of project fees, including fees not yet withdrawn. Cannot change the rate, seller proceeds, NFT or BEM rights.

tradePoints(address).notice: Points use gross BNB volume in wei, excluding fees and gas. Both sides accrue exact raw units; display conversion is done separately.

withdrawFees().notice: Anyone may pay gas to collect project fees, but cannot choose the destination or touch seller proceeds. A rejecting recipient rolls back only this withdrawal; purchases and seller withdrawals stay usable.

userdoc.notice: Two-sided market. Resting bids escrow their full BNB principal. Ask takers pay +1%; bid takers receive principal less 1%. No vault changes.
